POINT_IN_TIME_SAFE.basis: validated declared 1m/5m/15m equity and 1m/5m crypto bar rows; no sidecar written

PARTIALLY_POINT_IN_TIME.basis: canonical daily and 1-hour bar rows without uniform per-row availability/completion metadata; overlapping derived rows excluded

TIMESTAMP_INSUFFICIENT.basis: not globally materialized; representative SEC, earnings, macro, news, feature and raw-bar records fail closed

CURRENT_SNAPSHOT_ONLY.basis: dataset-specific; current/profile records are classified when source context marks them snapshot-only

UNKNOWN.basis: dataset-specific; reserved for records with no usable timestamp fields

replay_safe_coverage.caveat: source-contract estimate, not a materialized normalized archive; overlapping context representations excluded

dataset_adapters.market_bar: validated completion/as-of contract; fail closed without it
dataset_adapters.sec_filing: period end separated from accepted/filing timestamp
dataset_adapters.fundamentals: period end separated from accepted/filing timestamp
dataset_adapters.earnings: event date separated from release timestamp
dataset_adapters.fred: observation period separated from release/vintage timestamp
dataset_adapters.news: event time separated from publication time
dataset_adapters.feature_snapshot: source/as-of time only; no inferred publication

external_data_gaps: short interest and ownership time series
recommended_next_phase: Metadata-only repair of existing SEC/FMP/FRED-compatible records and 1-hour completion metadata, then one narrowly scoped catalyst and quote/trade cohort if still required.
